purpose: HP-W2 implements standalone background describe/derive/verify. Small synthetic image, strict binding, filesystem, process-lock, fault and transport tests cover the new boundary. production.images also verifies shared RP-3 normalization extraction and the necessary GRAY-ICC correction for supported 1/L/LA images; tools audits routing and the authoring rulebook snapshot. B-HPW2-01 changes the shared web bundle license reader: tools covers current and legacy inventories and integrity, while delivery exercises a real web build and the isolated SSH/HTTP deployment and rollback path.
omitted: No additional production.solver/adapter/catalog, native, preflight or Chromium modules: no solver, adapter, catalog writer, runtime or browser behavior changes; delivery is selected for the changed shared web bundle validator. Shared decoder changes are confined to color normalization and directly covered by existing and new image tests; imported path/I/O helpers remain unchanged. No real puzzle replay, image generation, gallery or technical artifact upload. The development core supplies the required Windows player package.

test_changes.reason: Retain small synthetic regression cases for the persistent standalone API and its data integrity; executed only when production.images is selected, not as a new universal CI obligation.
Keep small synthetic current and legacy license inventory and tamper regressions for the persistent web bundle contract, run when tools is selected.
